command:
set -eu
cat > /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/kdc.conf <<'KDC_EOF'
[kdcdefaults]
    kdc_ports = 88
    kdc_tcp_ports = 88

[realms]
    BRANCH.TEST = {
        master_key_type = aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96
        acl_file = /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/kadm5.acl
        dict_file = /usr/share/dict/words
        admin_keytab = /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/kadm5.keytab
        supported_enctypes = aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96:normal aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96:normal
    }
KDC_EOF
printf '*/admin@BRANCH.TEST *\n' > /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/kadm5.acl
chmod 600 /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/kdc.conf /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/kadm5.acl
if [ ! -f /var/kerberos/krb5kdc/principal ]; then
  master_pw=$(openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -d '\n')
  kdb5_util create -s -r BRANCH.TEST -P "$master_pw"
  unset master_pw
fi
if ! kadmin.local -r BRANCH.TEST -q 'getprinc analyst@BRANCH.TEST' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  analyst_pw=$(openssl rand -base64 36 | tr -d '\n')
  umask 077
  printf '%s' "$analyst_pw" > /root/.analyst-krb5-password
  kadmin.local -r BRANCH.TEST -q "addprinc -pw $analyst_pw analyst@BRANCH.TEST"
  unset analyst_pw
fi
